alternatives.root_cause: The cart-hotfix image wrote or reads cart records with an incompatible schema, making this a bad artifact rollout.
alternatives.why_not: The last image change reverted at 09:29, nearly two hours before onset, so the running artifact at onset is the baseline image.

alternatives.root_cause: Checkout itself fails to assemble orders.
alternatives.why_not: Checkout's error text is a propagated cart RPC failure; every failing checkout span has a cart error child and its other dependencies are clean.

alternatives.root_cause: Cart's store is unreachable or out of resources.
alternatives.why_not: The store read spans complete normally and cart keeps logging and serving most requests, so nothing was exhausted or unreachable - the bytes read were undecodable.

verdict.summary: Cart's Valkey-backed store returns cart records that cannot be deserialized, so GetCart fails with a protobuf decode error and checkout aborts the order.
verdict.reasoning: checkout alerted first but its failing spans terminate at cart's GetCart, which returns a FailedPrecondition whose detail is a protobuf parse failure while reading cart storage (tr_c2d1c5ea6347); the underlying store call itself completes in sub-millisecond time, so the connection is healthy and the contents are what cannot be read. Cart is not silent and not slow (tr_69d776be732d), ruling out freeze, partition and dependency latency, and its error ratio is a minority of calls, consistent with only certain corrupted keys failing (tr_ef85e1636eae). The change log for cart shows only a repeating automated image set/revert cycle that last ended ~1h50m before the 11:17-11:19 onset (tr_561be9930699, tr_15e5b94850b3), so no artifact change coincides with onset, demoting bad_deploy.
open_questions: Whether the corruption affects only specific user keys or a contiguous range of the keyspace
Whether the repeated cart-hotfix image cycling earlier in the day wrote records in an incompatible encoding now being read back
Valkey-side health and persistence state were not directly observed
